title: ASUS Republic of Gamers launches ROG G1000 Gaming Desktop and ROG Edition 20 Gears in the Philippines
summary: ASUS Republic of Gamers (ROG) Philippines today announced the arrival of its latest flagship desktop and gaming lifestyle gear, redefining immersive performance and gamer mobility for local…

blocks.text: ASUS Republic of Gamers (ROG) Philippines today announced the arrival of its latest flagship desktop and gaming lifestyle gear, redefining immersive performance and gamer mobility for local enthusiasts. Designed for ultra-enthusiasts who demand uncompromising power, cutting-edge thermal engineering, and standout personal expression, the new lineup brings bold innovation both on and off the desk.

Leading the charge is the ROG G1000, a revolutionary step forward in gaming performance, personalization and thermal efficiency, with limited edition ROG Edition 20 gears designed to protect your setup while celebrating two decades of pioneering gaming innovation.
ROG G1000 (GM1000TY): A GAMING DESKTOP WITH HOLOGRAPHIC INNOVATION

The ROG G1000 redefines what a gaming desktop can be, combining extreme performance with show-stopping innovation. At its core, the built-in AniMe Holo fan is the world’s first holographic fan system in a prebuilt gaming PC that can project customizable holographic visuals, transforming the environment into a medium of personal expression.

The AniMe Holo module is housed in an independent chamber that incorporates the hinge-door design, ensuring airflow does not interfere with the main components’ thermal path and helping reduce overall system noise by limiting vibration from the Holo system. The ROG Thermal Atrium, dedicated for CPU cooling, channels fresh air through 420 mm AIO liquid cooler with three fans and isolated airflow paths, ensuring critical components remain cool and stable during extended gaming sessions.

Equipped with ROG Astral GeForce RTX 5080 and support for up to 128GB DDR5 memory, the G1000 is tuned and ready for peak performance. The 104L ultra tower chassis enhances airflow, accommodates larger cooling hardware, and supports easy maintenance, while the Fan Key unleashes maximum airflow when you need it, with a single touch.

Customization is extensive with Armoury Crate and Aura Sync, letting users control RGB lighting across GPU, cooling fans, water-cooling blocks, and the AniMe Holo, delivering a system that is as visually striking as it is powerful. The G1000 gives gamers and creators the confidence to push limits without compromise.
The ROG G1000 (GM1000TY) will be available at select ROG Exclusive Stores at an introductory price of PHP 399,995.
ROG EDITION 20 GAMING GEARS: Innovate. Perform. Dominate.
ROG SLASH Backpack Edition 20

Celebrating the 20th anniversary of ROG, the ROG SLASH Backpack Edition 20 reflects the brand’s lifestyle ethos through a functional, premium, and stylish design. It features a black-and-translucent-gold palette accented by the signature ROG SLASH pattern woven into every detail.

An adjustable roll-top design allows users to expand or condense the backpack to suit varying loads, providing total control over capacity on the go. The front face features a custom ROG 20th anniversary FIDLOCK Magnetic quick-release buckle in matching black-and-translucent-gold, keeping gear securely fastened during travel.

Built to accommodate up to an 18-inch laptop alongside peripherals and additional essentials, the backpack offers flexible storage for both short trips and extended travel. Crafted from high-end materials, the ROG SLASH Backpack Edition 20 delivers a distinct look while maintaining everyday practicality.
The limited-edition ROG SLASH Backpack Edition 20 will be available at ROG Exclusive Stores in Q4 2026 for PHP10,995.
ROG SLASH Hard-Case Luggage Edition 20

The ROG SLASH Hard-case Luggage Edition 20 ensures all gear arrives safely at its destination. Featuring the same black-and-translucent-gold palette as the Edition 20 SLASH Backpack, this limited-edition luggage incorporates a stainless gold-steel plate, bringing ROG’s iconic DNA to every journey

A 100% polycarbonate outer shell backed by an aluminum frame with reinforced corners adds structural rigidity without extra weight, allowing it to easily handle airport baggage claims. The 360-degree silent skate wheels feature enhanced shock absorption and a new translucent black design for smoother rolling and refined travel performance

True to the ROG brand, the hard-case luggage includes a specialized compartment designed specifically for gaming equipment. Laptops, handhelds, and accessories fit securely inside the luggage for added peace of mind, while a removable foam divider featuring a woven ROG 20th Anniversary tag allows users to customize the interior layout to their exact needs.
Also available at ROG Exclusive Stores in Q4 2026, the ROG SLASH Hard-Case Luggage Edition 20 is priced at PHP 15,995.
